content: { "rules": [ "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices - forecast bias to the downside by ~0.1-0.3", "True prices exhibit strong mean reversion from extreme highs/lows back to center values", "Sentiment turning from positive (1.00) to negative (0.00) correlates with price pullbacks", "When sentiment is negative, model underforecasts more severely relative to true prices", "Price volatility increases in model forecasts compared to true outcomes - forecast overshoots range", "Model fails to capture the lagged response where prices gradually converge to fundamental values", "Sentiment persistence (maintained positive/negative values) aligns with price trends in the model", "When history shows upward momentum, model lag causes forecasts to be too low relative to continuing trends" ] }
